identificationModule.briefTitle: mFOLFIRINOX Plus Anlotinib and Sintilimab for Advanced Pancreatic Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: mFOLFIRINOX Combined With Anlotinib and Sintilimab as First-Line Therapy for Locally Advanced or Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer: A Prospective, Single-arm, Multicenter, Phase Ib/II Clinical Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is a prospective, single-arm, multicenter, phase Ib/II clinical trial that treats previously untreated patients with locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer using mFOLFIRINOX in combination with anlotinib and sintilimab. The purpose of this trial is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of this treatment regimen and to preliminarily explore the correlation between biomarkers and treatment outcomes.

armGroups.label: mFOLFIRINOX Plus Anlotinib and Sintilimab
armGroups.description:
Phase Ib: 6 patients will receive treatment at dose level-0 and their toxicity will be observed. If 2 or fewer patients experience dose-limiting toxicity, the study will proceed to the phase II part using dose level-0 as the treatment dose. If 3 or more patients have dose-limiting toxicity, another 6 patients will be accrued at a lower dose (dose -1). If two or fewer patients have dose-limiting toxicity, then we proceed with the phase II trial at that dose; otherwise, the trial is discontinued.

Dose level - 0: anlotinib at a dose of 10mg per administration, once daily, orally administered on days 1-14, every 3 weeks.

Dose level -1: anlotinib at a dose of 8mg per administration, once daily, orally administered on days 1-14, every 3 weeks.

Phase II: The efficacy and safety of mFOLFIRINOX combined with anlotinib and sintilimab as first-line treatment for locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer will be conducted at the anlotinib safe dose determined in phase Ib.

interventions.name: Anlotinib combined with Sintilimab
interventions.description: Based on the mFOLFIRINOX chemotherapy regimen, combined with the safe dose of anlotinib determined in phase Ib and sintilimab.

primaryOutcomes.description: The Objective response rate (ORR) was defined as the complete response (CR) rate or the partial response (PR) rate according to RECIST v1.1.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Four weeks after the initiation of medication until the day before surgery

secondaryOutcomes.description: The Overall survival (OS) was defined as the time between receiving treatment and observing death or loss of follow-up for any reason.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of enrollment until the date of death from any cause, assessed up to 60 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: The Progression free survival (PFS) was defined as the time between the start of treatment and the progression of intrahepatic and/or extrahepatic tumors, or the occurrence of death or loss of follow-up for any reason.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of enrollment until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 60 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: The Disease control rate (DCR) was defined as the complete response (CR) rate or the partial response (PR) rate or stable disease (SD) rate according to RECIST v1.1.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Four weeks after the initiation of medication until the day before surgery

secondaryOutcomes.description: Grade 1-5 AEs according to NCI-CTCAE V5.0.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the initiation of medication, with recordings made whenever an adverse reaction occurs, assessed up to 60 months
